description:
A legume gene's counterparts in the other legume genomes in one call: chickpea CDC Frontier v3, wild Cicer
reticulatum and C. echinospermum, lentil CDC Redberry v2 and CDC Greenstar, pea Cameor v1a, faba bean Hedin/2 v1
and v2, narrow-leafed lupin Tanjil, common bean, soybean, cowpea, mungbean, pigeonpea, peanut and Medicago. For each species the counterpart gene(s) with the evidence behind each: synteny (the gene pair
sits in a collinear block; block size in anchor genes), Ensembl Compara orthology (Ensembl species pairs only),
shared LIS legume gene family, best protein hit; plus location, genome browser link, highest baseline expression
(TPM, tissue/condition) and QTL / GWAS markers within qtl_window_kb. gene: chickpea Ca1g000100, lentil
Lcu.2RBY.1g000010 or Greenstar Lcu.1GRN.1g000010, faba v2 Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001, C. reticulatum Cr1g000100,
an Ensembl gene ID or name (Psat1g000040, GLYMA_15G049200). For chickpea Ca_ IDs convert first with
legume_pangene. species: limit to these (ids or names).
name: legume_compare
